qualification_limits: Historical object 488 and its JavaScript damage, material, weight and value are unavailable. Stock requires a builder-selected native electrical weapon. The acceptance profile explicitly uses 6 damage, 4 pain and 2 stun; historical damage parity is not asserted.

All grades use the exact native deadline (24+rand(1,6))*90*grade*0.75 seconds. This is the recovered loop's nominal conversion, excluding historical batching and load delay; no grade-seven permanence is introduced.

Native acceptance uses controlled world/anatomy catalogues, deterministic checks, specialized caster Save and explicit HelplessDefenseMove. It exercises real items, Body inventory, native room/zone/shard rollback, melee damage, wound persistence and fresh-process readers, but not full production boot/Telnet, autonomous attack selection, defences or concurrency.

The approved grade-seven 95-percent raw-cap gate is verified for overreach from controlled grade six, with no payment below the gate and route preflight at the boundary. A paid overreach cast is not qualified. Paid controlled grade-seven casting is qualified separately.

The actual native placement fault occurs after Get: a Held callback drops the output. Post-Wield custody revalidation has durable mock regression evidence, but an actual native post-Wield callback scenario was not run.

Earlier stock/integration packets remain immutable; their other historical native checks were not rerun for Storm Spear. Queued servitor control still needs accepted-action grant provenance and execution-time deadline revalidation while animation lives, preserving independent following.

Complete installer, all remaining stock/support/acquisition/crafting/chargen/energy wiring, portable production, remaining effect/lifecycle/topology/charm work and all whole-plan native release gates remain required. Seven phases, 16 decisions, 154 candidates, 82 Sorcerer plus 12 support rows and 25 acceptance scenarios are preserved.

Only a local commit is authorized. No publication, remote merge, deployment, shared/production database, billing, quota reset or model change occurred. Stop for parent independent review before later repertoire work.
